/** sgml-stream-codegen is MIT licensed, see /LICENSE. */
// Run as a .hack file in an isolated project with both generated HTML libraries
// and their dependencies available to the autoloader. This lives as .hack.txt
// because the generator does not depend on its generated libraries.
use namespace HTL\HTMLStream as H;

<<__EntryPoint>>
async function main(): Awaitable<void> {
  // A null expectation means the renderer must reject children.
  foreach (
    dict[
      'namespaced/article empty' => tuple(<H:article />, '<article></article>'),
      'namespaced/article text' =>
        tuple(<H:article>text</H:article>, '<article>text</article>'),
      'namespaced/area' => tuple(<H:area />, '<area>'),
      'namespaced/embed' => tuple(<H:embed />, '<embed>'),
      'namespaced/param' => tuple(<H:param />, '<param>'),
      'namespaced/area text' => tuple(<H:area>text</H:area>, null),
      'namespaced/embed text' => tuple(<H:embed>text</H:embed>, null),
      'namespaced/param text' => tuple(<H:param>text</H:param>, null),
      'root/article empty' => tuple(<article />, '<article></article>'),
      'root/article text' =>
        tuple(<article>text</article>, '<article>text</article>'),
      'root/area' => tuple(<area />, '<area>'),
      'root/embed' => tuple(<embed />, '<embed>'),
      'root/param' => tuple(<param />, '<param>'),
      'root/area text' => tuple(<area>text</area>, null),
      'root/embed text' => tuple(<embed>text</embed>, null),
      'root/param text' => tuple(<param>text</param>, null),
    ] as $name => list($element, $expected)
  ) {
    try {
      $actual = await $element->toHTMLStringAsync();
    } catch (\HH\InvariantException $e) {
      invariant(
        $expected === null &&
          \HH\Lib\Str\contains($e->getMessage(), 'may not have children'),
        'Unexpected rejection: %s: %s',
        $name,
        $e->getMessage(),
      );
      echo $name.': REJECTED children'."\n";
      continue;
    }
    invariant(
      $actual === $expected,
      'Unexpected output: %s: %s',
      $name,
      $actual,
    );
    echo $name.': '.$actual."\n";
  }
}
